description: A red string lies across the bed with a couple of beads already on it, and there’s a big pile of loose colorful beads nearby along with a tape dispenser. The left hand holds the end of the red string steady while the right hand reaches to the bead pile, pinches a bead, brings it back, and threads it onto the string, then both hands briefly work close together to slide and position the bead along the cord before the right hand lets go and reaches for another.
